summary: Warnings for Afatinib include diarrhea that can cause serious water loss and kidney failure, as well as severe skin issues like peeling and blistering sores [4]. A small computer model, rather than tests on actual people, gave the drug a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart problems [M]. Additionally, a similar medicine carries severe warnings for liver injury and blood issues [3]. One clinical trial involving Afatinib was stopped early because of high levels of harmful side effects and slow enrollment [6].
